name: Planar Rift
disable: DC 33 Thievery check (master) to assemble a rift seal using objects strongly grounded to your plane, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the rift

items.name: Into the Great Beyond
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the rift.

---

Effect The triggering creature and all creatures within 30 feet of the rift are drawn into another plane. Each creature can attempt a DC 33 Reflex save save to avoid this fate.

text: A rift attempts to draw creatures into another plane (the GM chooses the specific plane).
